'''Sorelle''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]], a [[Dreamer]] and the daughter of [[Adan]] and [[Siedre]].

== History ==
She died at age twenty during the Aiel travels during the Breaking. She was a Dreamer and dreamed of her own death coming from a fever.{{ref/book|4|26}}

==Errata==
She is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but this term did not exist until long after her death. She should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sorelle}}
